items.name: Legislative Branch
items.mission: Exercise federal legislative, appropriations, representation, and oversight powers within constitutional limits.

items.name: Executive Branch
items.mission: Execute federal law and administer authorized national programs, diplomacy, defense, and public services.

items.name: Judicial Branch
items.mission: Exercise the federal judicial power in cases and controversies within constitutionally and statutorily established jurisdiction.
items.establishment_basis: U.S. Constitution, Article III; lower courts established by Congress
